verdict.rationale: Formant's on-robot agent and Agent SDK ingest telemetry from the device into the cloud, and you can configure which data sources and streams are uploaded. Bandwidth-aware policy is also documented: per-stream rate limits, a hard FORMANT_UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT_KBPS ceiling on asset uploads, and a low-bandwidth mode that reduces the agent's passive data use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and details on offline buffering/store-and-forward of telemetry during connectivity loss.
